name: IIA Summer Open April 2017

venue.name: Orchids The Intenational School, BTM, Bangalore
venue.address: Amara Canopy, 4th A Main, Munivenkatppa Layout, BTM Layout 2, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076, India

information:
Pre-register on WCA on or before April 20, 2017.
Pay via PAYTM on the given numbers on of before April 20, 2017.
Participation fee is INR 500 per participant + INR 50 contribution towards Indian Cubing Community (Total INR 550 only)
Full time volunteers (selected by organizers) are exempt from payment of participation fee.
Registrations will be confirmed within 48 hours of making the payment according to the given guidelines. 
Maximum 200 participants on first payment basis.
Spot registration will be subject to availability of slots. Spot registration fee is INR 1050 only.
